prompt: <image1> shows a creature. Draw the same creature at its next, more grown-up stage. The whole silhouette changes: it becomes a majestic, calm lagoon dragon sitting upright and proud like a cat; the two pairs of wings are folded up high behind its back like a soft fan; the gill fronds have grown into a soft coral crown; the long tail wraps around its front feet; the silhouette is compact, about as wide as tall. Keep the face, the coral cheeks, the three soft coral gill fronds on each side of the head, the cream belly stripe from chin to tail tip and the flat style without outlines; the body is light warm apricot (#FFC56E), not orange. Fins and wings are coral, never turquoise or green. No teeth, no claws. Full body, plain flat pale mint background.
